# ROGLE

> ROGLE (Reengineering Operations GroupWork Logistics Excellence) is a research group of the Department of Business Organization of the Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV), Spain, founded in 2006. It does research and teaching on operations management, production planning and scheduling, logistics and supply chains, work organization, human resources management and industrial sustainability.

The group has 13 members, 1163 publications since 2001 and 155 research projects. Every publication has its own page with the APA citation, BibTeX and RIS, and links to the open-access copy in RiUNET when there is one. Titles keep their original language (Spanish or English). Contact: rogle@upv.es.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/index.html): the group, its aims and its 20th anniversary (in Spanish: [Inicio](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/index.html)).
- [Members](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members.html): Researchers of the group, with ORCID, links and their publications. ([Español](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/miembros.html))
- [Research](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/research.html): Research lines, projects, publications, and conference papers and talks. ([Español](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/investigacion.html))
- [Teaching](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/teaching.html): Teaching of operations management and teaching materials. ([Español](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/docencia.html))
- [Resources](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/resources.html): Open resources of the group. ([Español](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/recursos.html))
- [News](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/news.html): News of the group. ([Español](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/noticias.html))
- [Contact](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/contact.html): Address and e-mail of the group. ([Español](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/es/contacto.html))

## Data

- [All publications in BibTeX](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/descargas/rogle-publicaciones.bib): every publication of the group.
- [All publications in CSV](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/descargas/rogle-publicaciones.csv) and [all projects in CSV](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/descargas/rogle-proyectos.csv): the tables of the group database.
- [Full list as text](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/llms-full.txt): members, projects and publications, one line each.
- [Sitemap](https://rogle.webs.upv.es/sitemap.xml): every page, with its Spanish and English versions.
